title: Add multi-variant profiling and reporting pipeline (v42)
author: Priya Nair
description:
Motivation: provide a single, repeatable pipeline for multi-variant profiling and per-variant reporting so teams can compare latency/cost/quality across model variants and quantization profiles. This PR introduces a new Airflow DAG that aggregates profiling baselines (latency p50/p95/p99, memory, peak GPU usage, cold-start times), representative workload runners for mixed and chat-style workloads, and a reporting pipeline that writes aggregated metrics into the benchmark store for dashboarding.

What this PR does: - Adds airflow/dags/multi_variant_reporting.py to orchestrate profiling runs across variants and export summarized metrics. - Introduces runners/representative_runners/ mixed_workload_runner.py and chat_workload_runner.py with standard workload definitions and deterministic seeds to improve reproducibility. - Adds profiling/baselines/ configs and templates for CPU/GPU/memory sampling, cold-start measurement, and KV-cache warmup sequences. - Adds a lightweight exporter to benchmark_store/exporters/multi_variant_exporter.py to normalize per-run metrics into our reporting schema. - Adds end-to-end tests under tests/bench that run a short synthetic workload locally in CI to assert stable metrics and DAG wiring.

Checklist: - [x] Airflow DAG added and unit-tested locally - [x] Representative runners added with config + examples - [x] Exporter normalizes percentiles, histograms, and pause/resume events - [x] CI pipeline updated to run a short profiling smoke test - [x] Documentation added (docs/benchmark-lab/multi-variant-profiling.md)

Rollout plan: merge to main after approvals, enable DAG in staging for a week to gather baseline metrics, then enable in production benchmark-lab namespace. Feature is behind a config flag: BENCH_ENABLE_MULTI_VARIANT=true.

Notes: kept changes small in core runtime and isolated most logic to the benchmark-lab repo so rollout is low-risk. Key configs (sampling_rate_ms, warmup_steps, run_repetitions) are templated and can be tuned per workspace.

review_comments: Evan Chen: Can we parameterize the sampling_rate_ms at runtime? Some workloads need 1ms sampling to catch GPU spikes. Suggest exposing via env var and documenting expected cost impact.
Priya Nair (author): Added BENCH_SAMPLING_MS env var and documented tradeoffs in docs. Kept default 10ms to limit overhead in CI.
Sofia Patel: Tests look good, but please add an assertion for cold-start <= 500ms on the small synthetic model to detect regressions.
Priya Nair: Added cold-start assertion to tests and a retry-backoff for transient infra flakes. Recorded baseline values in tests/bench/expected_baselines.json
Arjun Rao: minor: the DAG schedule should be configurable via Airflow Variable instead of hardcoding '@daily'. Also request to add a small integration smoke job in staging namespace first.
Priya Nair: Updated DAG to respect AIRFLOW__VARIABLES__SCHEDULE or fallback to '@daily'. Added staging rollout note in runbook. Marking resolved.

Configurable via BENCH_ENABLE_MULTI_VARIANT and BENCH_SAMPLING_MS. Backwards-compatible and feature-flagged.
